text:
Aisha: If you could pick any fictional character to sit next to you at work for a week, who would you pick and why? keep it practical or hilarious, your choice.
Tom: Leslie Knope — relentless positivity, will bring snacks and themed sticky notes. office morale = instant upgrade. :star2:
Riley: T'Challa — calm, dignified, and probably an excellent meeting moderator. also offers tea.
Priya: Hermione Granger. solves problems, organizes the docs, and would definitely have a better system for tracking PRs. :books:
Carlos: Tony Stark. fixes the infra spontaneously but also breaks the coffee machine on day 1. :skull:
Maya: Chewbacca. will protect my desk plants and chew on cords if needed. :dog:
Riley: Also voting for Baymax — practical support bot, would literally patch you up after a rough sprint.
Tom: @Priya Hermione would also alphabetize the snack drawer and make it a required SOP. :laughing:
buddy-bot: reminder: virtual poll created — react with :thumbsup: to vote for your pick, :heart: for your backup pick.
Priya: voted :raised_hands: Hermione.
Aisha: LOL @Tom that alphabetized snack drawer is a feature I need. anyone else think Gandalf would be the best for shutting down bad meetings?
Carlos: I'm lobbying for Gandalf. "YOU SHALL NOT PASS" = perfect meeting control. :sparkles:
Maya: @Carlos yes. Gandalf + Chewie = chaos control and security. :boom:
Riley: this thread is my new favorite form of team building. emoji time. :thumbsup: :heart: :tada:
Tom: dropping a celebratory gif link: https://giphy.com/gifs/office-parkbench (pretend it's perfectly relevant)
Aisha: Thanks everyone — tiny escape from the day, made my afternoon. we should maybe do a real 5-min "who would you seat" round in #random next week? :smile:
